title: Summit Retro Credits: Booking Channel Miles
content:
When a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program retro credit appears on the member's activity statement, it may include miles for the channel through which the credited ticket was booked. The booking channel is the one the ticket's record under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter shows.

**What the credit includes**

- A ticket booked in the Crestline app: 10 percent of the credit's base miles, rounded down to the whole mile.
- A ticket booked on the Crestline website: 5 percent of the credit's base miles, rounded down to the whole mile.
- A ticket booked through any other channel: no booking-channel miles.

The base miles are the eligible fare multiplied by the award miles per dollar of the tier the member holds on the day the credit posts, rounded to the nearest whole mile with halves rounded up. The channel miles are computed on the base miles and added to the miles the credit carries.

**Illustration on hypothetical base miles**

| Base miles | Booked in the Crestline app | Booked on the Crestline website | Booked through another channel |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2231 | 223 (from 223.1) | 111 (from 111.55) | 0 |
| 1999 | 199 (from 199.9) | 99 (from 99.95) | 0 |

The second row shows that the rounding is always downward, even when the fraction is close to a whole mile.
